page.acrossEveryWorkspaceAtTheCap: Across every {@workspace.one}. At the cap, everything stops starting until the window turns.
page.atTheCapNewRunsAre: · at the cap, new runs are refused until {turns}
page.everyCapHereIsTheBudget: Every cap here is the budget: line in that {@workspace.one}'s AGENTS.md, editable in either place. A flow can also carry its own per-run budget:, and so can an agent — the most it may spend in one run. Both are hard caps that stop a step mid-turn, and both live in their own files.
page.howMuchMayBeSpentIn: How much may be spent in a day, a week or a month before runs stop starting — and where the warnings sit. Unset is no limit.
page.warningsHaveNowhereToGoThe: Warnings have nowhere to go: the account has no notify: destination. <link>Set one</link>.
